if.test: varianceType != null and varianceType != '' and varianceType != 'ALL'

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, NVL(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)), 0) AS TOTAL_VARIANCE, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT > 0 THEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS POSITIVE_VARIANCE, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT < 0 THEN ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NEGATIVE_VARIANCE, NVL(SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_BUDGET, CASE WHEN SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)) / SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 100, 2) END AS VARIANCE_RATE FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') AS MONTH_KEY, TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'MM') || '月' AS MONTH_LABEL, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT > 0 THEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS POSITIVE_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT < 0 THEN ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NEGATIVE_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)) / SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 100, 2) END AS RATE FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME) >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM'), TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'MM') || '月' ORDER BY MONTH_KEY ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || 'Q' || TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'Q') AS QUARTER_KEY, TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || '年Q' || TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'Q') AS QUARTER_LABEL, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT > 0 THEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS POSITIVE_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT < 0 THEN ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NEGATIVE_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)) / SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 100, 2) END AS RATE FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME) >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -18) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || 'Q' || TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'Q'), TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || '年Q' || TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'Q') ORDER BY QUARTER_KEY ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') AS YEAR_KEY, TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || '年' AS YEAR_LABEL, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT > 0 THEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS POSITIVE_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN VARIANCE_AMOUNT < 0 THEN ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NEGATIVE_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)) / SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 100, 2) END AS RATE FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME) >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -60) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY'), TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || '年' ORDER BY YEAR_KEY ASC

SELECT NVL(ORGANIZATION_NAME, '未知部门') AS DIST_NAME, NVL(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)), 0) AS DIST_VALUE FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND ABS(NVL(VARIANCE_AMOUNT, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY DIST_VALUE DESC

SELECT NVL(ACCOUNT_NAME, '未知科目') AS DIST_NAME, NVL(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)), 0) AS DIST_VALUE FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND ABS(NVL(VARIANCE_AMOUNT, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY ACCOUNT_NAME ORDER BY DIST_VALUE DESC

SELECT CASE VARIANCE_TYPE WHEN 'POSITIVE' THEN '正差异' WHEN 'NEGATIVE' THEN '负差异' WHEN 'ZERO' THEN '无差异' ELSE NVL(VARIANCE_TYPE, '其他') END AS DIST_NAME, NVL(SUM(ABS(VARIANCE_AMOUNT)), 0) AS DIST_VALUE FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY VARIANCE_TYPE ORDER BY DIST_VALUE DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(ANALYZED_TIME, 'YYYY"年"Q"季度"') AS PERIOD_NAME, NVL(SUM(BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) AS BUDGET_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(ACTUAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS ACTUAL_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(VARIANCE_AMOUNT), 0) AS VARIANCE_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND ID = #{id} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(ANALYZED_TIME, 'YYYY"年"Q"季度"') ORDER BY PERIOD_NAME ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BUDGET_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS SET VARIANCE_REASON = #{varianceReason}, IMPROVEMENT_MEASURES = #{improvementMeasures}, REVIEWED_BY = #{reviewedBy}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id} AND DEL_FLAG = 0
